method: At each month-end t from v1.0's first positions (2006-01) to 2019-12: v1.0's held positions after the no-trade band (em_macro.systematic.run(build_inputs(), DESIGN['signals']).attrs['weights'], frozen design, read only); carry of each held instrument at t as the algorithm defines it (build_inputs: FX = local policy rate minus fed funds, monthly averages; EM bonds = 10y yield minus local policy rate; euro spreads = the spread; DE10Y = yield minus policy rate; percentage points a year; the latest available month when t is missing); book carry at constant risk = sum over the held positions of signed weight (fraction of capital) x carry, FX and bonds together, NOT divided by gross exposure: pp a year on capital. v1.0 is always scaled to its 10% volatility target, so this is the carry the book earns per year at constant risk. Weights are v1.0's raw month-end weights (live: size_pct_of_capital / 100 in results/systematic/positions.csv; no adjustment, override or later decision such as D005 is applied to either side). Threshold = the 10th percentile of the monthly values (linear interpolation, as numpy.percentile). Only month-ends to 2019-12 are used; no 2020+ value enters the threshold.
source: Frozen v1.0 code em_macro/systematic.py (tag v1.0-frozen, commit 7886867) on the repository's processed panels (data/processed/daily_panel.csv, country_month_panel.csv) and the public series it downloads (FRED DFF, DEXUSUK, DEXUSEU; BIS policy rates and CPI; Banco de la Republica TRM; Banco Central de Chile dolar observado). The S&P 500 benchmark download is stubbed (not a position input). Monthly values: results/v1_rules/carry_spread_2005_2019.csv.
live_status_at_freeze: No live month has been evaluated: the first live month-end (2026-11) is booked at the 3 Dec 2026 run. Only the 2026-10 baseline (positions at the live start) had been computed, under each definition, and it is re-run under this one.

definition_changes.from: equal-weighted mean carry of the long positions minus that of the short positions
definition_changes.to: sum of signed weight x carry divided by gross exposure (position-weighted, per unit of gross)
definition_changes.why: The equal-weighted spread was dominated by TRY (carry about 33pp at the 2026-10 month-end): one instrument moved the average of a three-to-five-name side by several points, whatever its size in the book.

definition_changes.from: sum of signed weight x carry divided by gross exposure (position-weighted, per unit of gross)
definition_changes.to: sum of signed weight x carry over v1.0's raw positions, NOT divided by gross exposure (book carry at constant risk)
definition_changes.why: Dividing by gross exposure let large low-volatility euro positions drag the measure down: euro spreads and the Bund averaged about 48% of gross exposure in 2006-2019 at carry under 1pp, so the per-gross threshold (0.52pp) was out of reach for the live book (8.14pp at the 2026-10 baseline, no euro positions). The book is always scaled to the 10% volatility target, so the undivided sum is the carry it earns per year at constant risk, comparable across books of different composition. This definition is final.

note: Computed once for D004 and never recomputed or edited; ledger/v1_rules.py pins this file's SHA-256.
